title: Stability Oracle: a structure-based graph-transformer framework for identifying stabilizing mutations
relevance: SOTA structure-based graph-transformer for stability prediction. Introduces thermodynamic permutations for data augmentation and structural amino acid embeddings. Key reference for GNN-based stability prediction.
key_finding: Graph-transformer with structural embeddings achieves SOTA on identifying thermodynamically stabilizing mutations.

title: AlphaGMut: A Rationale-Guided Alpha Shape Graph Neural Network to Evaluate Mutation Effects
relevance: Uses alpha shapes of protein structures for atomic-resolution graph representation. Outperforms AlphaMissense in many metrics. Demonstrates GNN on structural graphs for mutation prediction.
key_finding: Alpha shape-based GNN with rationale guidance outperforms AlphaMissense on pathogenicity prediction and works in alignment-free settings.

title: ProS-GNN: Predicting effects of mutations on protein stability using graph neural networks
relevance: Gated GNN with atom features for protein stability change prediction. Demonstrates message passing for encoding mutation-structure links.
key_finding: Gated GNN achieves improved linearity with symmetry in stability prediction while suppressing anti-symmetric bias.

title: Structure-based self-supervised learning enables ultrafast protein stability prediction upon mutation (Pythia)
relevance: Self-supervised GNN for zero-shot ddG prediction with 10^5-fold speedup. Explored 26 million protein structures. Demonstrates GNN scalability for stability prediction.
key_finding: Self-supervised GNN achieves competitive ddG prediction at 10^5x computational speedup over force-field methods.
